'''Paul Klarrk''' was<ref name="Rise" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi instructor|combat instructor]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Klarrk was dark-skinned with [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], wore brown and tan [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]], and carried two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="Rise" /> Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> Klarrk was stationed at the [[Avesta Plantation]], a [[Farm/Legends|farming plantation]] owned by the [[Avesta family]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], during the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] [[Conquest of Makeb|attempt]] to conquer the planet.<ref name="Rise" />

==Behind the scenes==
Paul Klarrk appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]]. Klarrk serves as the trainer for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class on the planet Makeb, which was introduced in the expansion.<ref name="Rise" />
